title: pedicularis longiflora var. tubiformis
intro: Pedicularis longiflora var. tubiformis, commonly known as Long-Flowered Lousewort or Tube Flower Pedicularis, is a plant species that belongs to the Pedicularis genus of flowering plants. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis longiflora var. tubiformis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and treat respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenylethanoid glycosides, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
